goal.objective: On each admitted StegVerse task-control opportunity, materialize the authority-neutral COSV packet for the latest jointly observed heartbeat reference, preserving a reconstructable state cache and deterministic gradient inputs without granting carrier or analytic authority.
success_predicates: The worker consumes only canonical local heartbeat/WorkerCoordinator observation state.
A new observed carrier reference produces a verified FULL or DELTA packet under receipts/cosv/live/**.
DELTA packets bind the previous packet SHA, unchanged-state root, current full-state root and deterministic gradient_inputs.
The task may be claimed through independently admitted task control without waiting for a heartbeat-carried compatibility trigger.
No GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is required or forwarded.
StegVerse remains primary and third-party runtime dependency is false.
failure_predicates: The worker mutates heartbeat carrier or worker authority state.
The worker fabricates a carrier reference not present in canonical observed state.
A packet fails digest/state-root reconstruction or authority invariants.
A heartbeat-carried compatibility trigger is treated as execution authority or a prerequisite for claimability.
A third-party runtime or NON-TV/TVC credential becomes required.
authority_ceiling: no claim/fence/lease mutation outside WorkerCoordinator task-control binding

task.derivation_reason: The first live HB31 packet proved the manual integration. Recurring packet production is repeated dependency-bound work and therefore belongs to existing WorkerCoordinator task control rather than chat observation or heartbeat-trigger authority.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted StegVerse task-control execution opportunity while the task remains active
activation.claim_generation_rule: fresh WorkerCoordinator fencing generation; no historical claim/fence reuse

completion.next_authorized_action: Existing WorkerCoordinator task control may independently claim this HANDOFF_READY task under a fresh fence. If canonical observed carrier state is newer than the latest persisted COSV packet, materialize and verify the next packet; otherwise emit NO_NEW_REFERENCE and remain active. No heartbeat compatibility trigger is required.
terminal_when: The broader COSV live integration goal is explicitly retired or superseded after required live gradient/introspection evidence is terminal; until then this packet producer remains recurring active infrastructure.
